correlation: Opaque batch ID for structured app requests; generation ID for legacy subject route; Cloudflare event timestamp and script version
fields: numeric moderation scores and fixed reason codes when valid
fixed failure classification and HTTP status where available
excluded: raw provider errors or exception messages
lifetime: Worker ctx.waitUntil for the direct subject route; DurableObjectState.waitUntil for shared batches. The first approval does not cancel the other service. Completion logs cannot revise a settled gate.
diagnosticLogRetention: Existing Cloudflare Worker seven-day retention; no new long-term log sink configured.
providerRetention: This audit covers Wonder Lines diagnostics. Direct TypeSafe processing and any independent provider retention remain governed by that service and its terms; no claim of provider-side zero retention.
tests: Scripts/test_parallel_moderation.mjs: credential/prompt sentinels across HTTP, malformed JSON, content-type, response-size, version and score failures; network error classification; independent bounded observation
Scripts/test_batch_moderation.mjs: three images start before Jev finishes, waitUntil retained, final disagreement logged, descriptions/credentials absent from logs
Scripts/test_moderation_calibration.mjs: 610 recorded scores replay through real coordinator
Scripts/test_privacy.mjs and Scripts/test_operational_events.mjs: existing privacy regressions
